content.json:
### ðŸ“– Help & Overview - Azure Tenant Certificate Monitoring

This workbook queries Azure Resource Graph (ARG) in real time across all selected subscriptions in your tenant.

#### Covered Certificate Asset Types:
1. **App Service Certificates (`microsoft.web/certificates`)**: Custom SSL certificates uploaded or managed for App Services.
2. **App Service Certificate Orders (`microsoft.web/certificateorders`)**: Managed GoDaddy / DigiCert orders through Azure, with auto-renew tracking.
3. **Web Apps & Custom Domain SSL Bindings (`microsoft.web/sites`)**: Maps App Service & Function App custom hostnames to their bound certificates, thumbprints, and live expiration dates.
4. **Application Gateways (`microsoft.network/applicationgateways`)**: SSL termination certificates, identifying whether they use **Azure Key Vault with auto-rotation** or **manually uploaded blobs**.
5. **API Management (`microsoft.apimanagement/service`)**: Custom domain endpoint certificates (Gateway, Portal, Management) and Key Vault integrations.
6. **Azure Front Door & CDN (`microsoft.cdn/profiles/customdomains`)**: Edge TLS configurations and custom domain validation status.
7. **Azure Key Vaults (`microsoft.keyvault/vaults`)**: Posture review (Soft Delete, Purge Protection) and Diagnostic Logging recommendations.

> [!NOTE]
> Azure Resource Graph requires Reader role on target subscriptions to read resource metadata.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.web/certificates'
| extend ExpirationDate = todatetime(properties.expirationDate)
| extend DaysRemaining = datetime_diff('day', ExpirationDate, now())
| summarize
    TotalCertificates = count(),
    Expired = countif(DaysRemaining < 0),
    Critical30Days = countif(DaysRemaining >= 0 and DaysRemaining <= 30),
    Warning60Days = countif(DaysRemaining > 30 and DaysRemaining <= 60),
    Attention90Days = countif(DaysRemaining > 60 and DaysRemaining <= 90),
    Healthy = countif(DaysRemaining > 90)
| extend Dummy = 1
| project-away Dummy
content.title: Certificate Health Overview (Tenant-Wide)

### ðŸ“Š Executive Expiry Breakdown & Timeline
Visual distribution of certificate lifecycles across status tiers, subscriptions, and geographic regions.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.web/certificates'
| extend ExpirationDate = todatetime(properties.expirationDate)
| extend DaysRemaining = datetime_diff('day', ExpirationDate, now())
| extend StatusTier = case(
    isnull(ExpirationDate), 'Unknown',
    DaysRemaining < 0, '1. Expired',
    DaysRemaining <= 30, '2. Critical (< 30 Days)',
    DaysRemaining <= 60, '3. Warning (31 - 60 Days)',
    DaysRemaining <= 90, '4. Attention (61 - 90 Days)',
    '5. Healthy (> 90 Days)'
)
| summarize Count = count() by StatusTier
| sort by StatusTier asc

content.json:
### ðŸ“œ App Service Certificates Inventory (`microsoft.web/certificates`)
All custom and managed SSL certificates uploaded to App Services across your subscriptions. Use the **Expiry Filter** above to isolate critical or expired certificates.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.web/certificates'
| extend ExpirationDate = todatetime(properties.expirationDate)
| extend IssueDate = todatetime(properties.issueDate)
| extend DaysRemaining = datetime_diff('day', ExpirationDate, now())
| extend ExpiryStatus = case(
    isnull(ExpirationDate), 'Unknown',
    DaysRemaining < 0, 'Expired',
    DaysRemaining <= 30, 'Critical (< 30 Days)',
    DaysRemaining <= 60, 'Warning (31 - 60 Days)',
    DaysRemaining <= 90, 'Attention (61 - 90 Days)',
    'Healthy (> 90 Days)'
)
| extend ExpiryFilterKey = case(
    isnull(ExpirationDate), 'Unknown',
    DaysRemaining < 0, 'Expired',
    DaysRemaining <= 30, 'Critical',
    DaysRemaining <= 60, 'Warning',
    DaysRemaining <= 90, 'Attention',
    'Healthy'
)
| where '{ExpiryThreshold}' == 'all' or ExpiryFilterKey == '{ExpiryThreshold}'
| extend Subject = tostring(properties.subjectName)
| extend Issuer = tostring(properties.issuer)
| extend Thumbprint = tostring(properties.thumbprint)
| extend KeyVaultId = tostring(properties.keyVaultId)
| extend IsValid = tostring(properties.valid)
| project Certificate = id, Subject, Issuer, ExpirationDate, DaysRemaining, ExpiryStatus, IsValid, Thumbprint, KeyVaultId, resourceGroup, subscriptionId
| sort by DaysRemaining asc
content.title: App Service Certificates Table
content.noDataMessage: No certificates match the selected subscription and threshold filters.

content.json:
### ðŸ›’ App Service Certificate Orders (`microsoft.web/certificateorders`)
Tracks domain certificate orders created via the Azure Portal, including auto-renew status, issuance state, and renewal deadlines.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.web/certificateorders'
| extend ExpirationTime = todatetime(properties.expirationTime)
| extend DaysRemaining = datetime_diff('day', ExpirationTime, now())
| extend ExpiryStatus = case(
    isnull(ExpirationTime), 'Unknown',
    DaysRemaining < 0, 'Expired',
    DaysRemaining <= 30, 'Critical (< 30 Days)',
    DaysRemaining <= 60, 'Warning (31 - 60 Days)',
    DaysRemaining <= 90, 'Attention (61 - 90 Days)',
    'Healthy (> 90 Days)'
)
| extend ExpiryFilterKey = case(
    isnull(ExpirationTime), 'Unknown',
    DaysRemaining < 0, 'Expired',
    DaysRemaining <= 30, 'Critical',
    DaysRemaining <= 60, 'Warning',
    DaysRemaining <= 90, 'Attention',
    'Healthy'
)
| where '{ExpiryThreshold}' == 'all' or ExpiryFilterKey == '{ExpiryThreshold}'
| extend Domain = tostring(properties.distinguishedName)
| extend ProductType = tostring(properties.productType)
| extend AutoRenew = tostring(properties.autoRenew)
| extend OrderStatus = tostring(properties.status)
| extend ProvisioningState = tostring(properties.provisioningState)
| extend KeyVaultId = tostring(properties.keyVaultId)
| project Order = id, Domain, ProductType, AutoRenew, OrderStatus, ProvisioningState, ExpirationTime, DaysRemaining, ExpiryStatus, KeyVaultId, resourceGroup, subscriptionId
| sort by DaysRemaining asc

content.json:
### ðŸŒ Web Apps & Custom Hostname SSL Bindings (`microsoft.web/sites`)
Correlates Web Apps and Function Apps with their custom domain SSL host bindings, bound certificate thumbprints, and live expiration dates.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.web/sites'
| mv-expand ssl = properties.hostNameSslStates
| extend sslState = tostring(ssl.sslState), hostName = tostring(ssl.name), thumbprint = tostring(ssl.thumbprint)
| where sslState != 'Disabled' and isnotempty(thumbprint)
| project siteId = id, siteName = name, hostName, sslState, thumbprint, kind, resourceGroup, subscriptionId
| join kind=leftouter (
    resources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.web/certificates'
    | extend ExpirationDate = todatetime(properties.expirationDate)
    | extend DaysRemaining = datetime_diff('day', ExpirationDate, now())
    | extend ExpiryStatus = case(
        isnull(ExpirationDate), 'Unknown',
        DaysRemaining < 0, 'Expired',
        DaysRemaining <= 30, 'Critical (< 30 Days)',
        DaysRemaining <= 60, 'Warning (31 - 60 Days)',
        DaysRemaining <= 90, 'Attention (61 - 90 Days)',
        'Healthy (> 90 Days)'
    )
    | extend ExpiryFilterKey = case(
        isnull(ExpirationDate), 'Unknown',
        DaysRemaining < 0, 'Expired',
        DaysRemaining <= 30, 'Critical',
        DaysRemaining <= 60, 'Warning',
        DaysRemaining <= 90, 'Attention',
        'Healthy'
    )
    | extend Subject = tostring(properties.subjectName)
    | extend Issuer = tostring(properties.issuer)
    | extend thumbprint = tostring(properties.thumbprint)
    | project certId = id, certName = name, Subject, Issuer, ExpirationDate, DaysRemaining, ExpiryStatus, ExpiryFilterKey, thumbprint
) on thumbprint
| where '{ExpiryThreshold}' == 'all' or isempty(ExpiryFilterKey) or ExpiryFilterKey == '{ExpiryThreshold}'
| project AppService = siteId, HostName = hostName, SSLState = sslState, Certificate = certId, Subject, Issuer, ExpirationDate, DaysRemaining, ExpiryStatus, Thumbprint = thumbprint, Kind = kind, resourceGroup, subscriptionId
| sort by DaysRemaining asc
content.title: Web Apps SSL Hostname Bindings & Expiry
content.noDataMessage: No active SSL host bindings found matching criteria.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways'
| mv-expand cert = properties.sslCertificates
| extend certName = tostring(cert.name)
| extend keyVaultSecretId = tostring(cert.properties.keyVaultSecretId)
| extend certProvisioningState = tostring(cert.properties.provisioningState)
| extend KeyVaultIntegration = iff(isnotempty(keyVaultSecretId), 'Integrated with Key Vault', 'âš ï¸ Manual Upload (Risk of Expiration)')
| extend AutoRotation = iff(isnotempty(keyVaultSecretId) and keyVaultSecretId !matches regex @'/[0-9a-f]{32}$', 'âœ… Auto-Rotate (Unversioned URI)', iff(isnotempty(keyVaultSecretId), 'âš ï¸ Pinned Version (Manual Update Req)', 'âŒ None (Embedded Cert)'))
| project ApplicationGateway = id, CertificateName = certName, KeyVaultIntegration, AutoRotation, KeyVaultSecretURI = keyVaultSecretId, ProvisioningState = certProvisioningState, location, resourceGroup, subscriptionId
| sort by KeyVaultIntegration asc, CertificateName asc

content.json:
#### ðŸ’¡ Why Directly Uploaded Certificates Require Decoding
Azure Application Gateway stores directly uploaded certificates as raw Base64 (publicCertData) without exposing an expirationDate property in Azure Resource Manager (ARM).

To display their **exact expiration date, days remaining, and expiry status** above:
1. Select your **Log Analytics Workspace** in the top parameter dropdown.
2. Run the included PowerShell script or schedule it in Azure Automation / Logic App:
   `powershell
   .\scripts\Sync-AppGatewayCertificatesToLogAnalytics.ps1 -WorkspaceId '<Workspace-ID>' -WorkspaceKey '<Workspace-Key>'
   `
The script decodes the X.509 certificate binary, extracts the NotAfter date, and ingests it into AppGatewayCertificates_CL.

### ðŸ”Œ API Management Custom Hostnames & Certificates (`microsoft.apimanagement/service`)
Audits API Management custom domain bindings (Gateway proxy, Developer Portal, Management Endpoint), tracking expiration and Key Vault links.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.apimanagement/service'
| mv-expand hostConfig = properties.hostnameConfigurations
| extend hostName = tostring(hostConfig.hostName)
| extend hostType = tostring(hostConfig.type)
| extend certExpiry = todatetime(hostConfig.certificate.expirationDate)
| extend certSubject = tostring(hostConfig.certificate.subject)
| extend certThumbprint = tostring(hostConfig.certificate.thumbprint)
| extend keyVaultId = tostring(hostConfig.keyVaultId)
| extend certSource = case(
    isnotempty(keyVaultId), 'Key Vault',
    isnotempty(certSubject), 'Custom Certificate',
    'Default / Managed'
)
| extend DaysRemaining = datetime_diff('day', certExpiry, now())
| extend ExpiryStatus = case(
    isnotempty(keyVaultId), 'Managed via Key Vault',
    isnull(certExpiry), 'Managed / Default',
    DaysRemaining < 0, 'Expired',
    DaysRemaining <= 30, 'Critical (< 30 Days)',
    DaysRemaining <= 60, 'Warning (31 - 60 Days)',
    DaysRemaining <= 90, 'Attention (61 - 90 Days)',
    'Healthy (> 90 Days)'
)
| extend ExpiryFilterKey = case(
    isnotempty(keyVaultId), 'KeyVault',
    isnull(certExpiry), 'Managed',
    DaysRemaining < 0, 'Expired',
    DaysRemaining <= 30, 'Critical',
    DaysRemaining <= 60, 'Warning',
    DaysRemaining <= 90, 'Attention',
    'Healthy'
)
| where '{ExpiryThreshold}' == 'all' or ExpiryFilterKey == '{ExpiryThreshold}'
| project APIMInstance = id, HostName = hostName, EndpointType = hostType, CertificateSource = certSource, ExpirationDate = certExpiry, DaysRemaining, ExpiryStatus, Subject = certSubject, Thumbprint = certThumbprint, KeyVaultSecretURI = keyVaultId, resourceGroup, subscriptionId
| sort by DaysRemaining asc
content.title: API Management Custom Hostnames & Certificate Expiration
content.noDataMessage: No API Management instances or custom hostnames found.

content.json:
#### ðŸ’¡ Enabling Real-Time Expiry Alerts for Azure Key Vault
Because Key Vault stores certificate private keys securely within the data plane, Azure Resource Graph inspects the vault metadata. To alert on individual certificate expirations inside Key Vault:

1. **Diagnostic Settings**: Route Key Vault `AuditEvent` logs to an Azure Log Analytics Workspace.
2. **Runbook / Azure Policy**: Assign Azure Policy *'Certificates should have the specified maximum validity period'* or assign an Event Grid trigger when certificates near expiry (`Microsoft.KeyVault.CertificateNearExpiry`).
3. **Log Analytics Query**:
```kusto
AzureDiagnostics
| where Category == "AuditEvent"
| where OperationName in ("CertificateNearExpiry", "CertificateExpired")
| project TimeGenerated, Resource, OperationName, ResultDescription, CallerIpAddress
```
